story.title: Over 200,000 Displaced Amid Renewed Fighting in Yemen, UN Reports
story.summary: The United Nations reports that more than 200,000 people have been displaced in Yemen due to escalating fighting between Houthi rebels and Saudi-backed government forces. The conflict has intensified in recent weeks, with thousands fleeing to Djibouti. The UN also warns that a significant portion of families in affected areas face hunger.

timeline_highlights.title: Yemen Government Forces Regain Control Near Bab el-Mandeb Strait
timeline_highlights.summary: Forces loyal to the Yemeni government have recaptured several strategic areas around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait from Houthi rebels. The operation, supported by the Saudi-led coalition, included the retaking of the town of Dhubab and other locations in the vicinity. This offensive aims to reclaim all territory held by the Iran-backed Houthis.

related_stories.title: Coco Gauff Exits China Open Following Exhausting Week of Racist Abuse
related_stories.summary: Coco Gauff expressed feeling overwhelmed and exhausted after experiencing significant online racist abuse during the China Open. Following her loss to Elise Mertens, she revealed that the emotional toll of the racism she faced contributed to her performance and overall well-being, stating she felt like she was going to pass out during the match.

related_stories.title: Malian Army and Russian Forces Regain Control of Kidal from Rebels
related_stories.summary: The Malian army, supported by Russian fighters, has retaken the northern city of Kidal, which was previously captured by Tuareg separatists in April. The separatists announced their withdrawal on Tuesday, allowing the military to advance into the city. This development marks a significant boost for Mali's junta and its Russian allies.

related_stories.title: Iran's Control Over Hormuz Strait Questioned by U.S. Officials
related_stories.summary: U.S. Senator Marco Rubio stated that Iran has 'lost complete control' of the Strait of Hormuz, noting that oil flow through the strait remains nearly unchanged despite ongoing conflicts. This assertion comes amid discussions on Iran's nuclear enrichment and its implications for the region.
